top_signals.title: Warsh's 'Ambitious Agenda' Needs Broad Market Understanding: Clarida
top_signals.summary:
Former Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Richard Clarida, and now a global economic adviser for Pimco, says said the central bank risks creating uncertainty if it alters its preferred inflation measure without clearly communicating what policymakers are targeting. Clarida offered that caution on Friday on "Bloomberg Money" in the wake of Chairman Kevin Warsh’s suggestion for a review of possible alternatives to the US personal consumption expenditure core index, known by the acronym PCE. Clarida speaks to Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Jake Paul on Landmark Merger Between MVP, PFL To Take on the UFC
top_signals.summary: Jake Paul's combat-sports company Most Valuable Promotions is merging with the Professional Fighters League, aiming to take on the Ultimate Fighting Championship. Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick & Vanessa Perdomo sat down with Jake Paul and Nakisa Bidarian, co-founders of Most Valuable Promotions, and John Martin, CEO of the newly formed company, to discuss the merger, and the roadmap ahead for the new company. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
